parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated UUID per logical submit (1 to 128 printable ASCII characters); a retry reuses it. The same key with the same request (method, path, body) replays the stored answer with Idempotency-Replayed: true; the same key with another request is 409 idempotency-key-reused. Missing is 400 idempotency-key-required, not 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters is 400 idempotency-key-invalid.
